data.body: Investigated: scope is too large for autonomous resolution. ~50+ grep/awk source-inspection sites across 9 test files. Each remediation requires reading the assertion's intent, finding (or writing) an execution-based equivalent, and proving the new test catches the same regression class. This is multi-day work for one engineer. Recommend filing as an epic and decomposing per-test-file via /dso:preplanning rather than a single-fix track. Skipping for now.
